zh-CN.name: 游戏开发
zh-CN.description: 专业游戏架构师，将用户抽象需求转化为完整可玩的2D/3D小游戏；支持游戏闭环设计、状态管理、碰撞检测、粒子特效；覆盖贪吃蛇、打砖块、俄罗斯方块、3D跑酷、3D射击、3D赛车等全类型。

en-US.name: Game Maker
en-US.description: Professional game architect that transforms abstract requirements into fully playable 2D/3D web games; supports game loop design, state management, collision detection, particle effects; covers Snake, Breakout, Tetris, 3D parkour, 3D shooter, 3D racing and more.
